operatingLeaseLiabilities.locator: Note 9 (annual) / Note 6 (quarter), total operating lease liability; current+noncurrent; retained as operating context, not added again to financial debt.

options.aggregateIntrinsicValue.locator: Annual Note11 intrinsic884m is for20m vested/expected options, not total21m. Full total not separately disclosed; preserved as null. Market intrinsic is not deducted from DCF equity.

otherClaims.name: Net unfunded defined-benefit pension obligation
otherClaims.basis: Annual Note11 aggregate net pension liability (funded status); quarterly carry because no update disclosed.

otherClaims.name: Short-term capital expenditure financing balance
otherClaims.basis: Separate cash-flow line exists outside the reconciled notes-payable schedule, but a standalone balance/opening is not disclosed. annual.note: Primary balance sheet, operations, cash flow and debt/lease/equity notes cross-checked in original filing. Restricted cash excluded. Finance leases added once; operating leases remain operating costs. Reported preferred carrying remains a source fact; model replaces it with maximum mandatory conversion shares and discounted scheduled dividends. Employee stock compensation remains in operating expenses. Investments and pension carrying values are economic-value proxies. Uncommenced leases and purchase commitments are future operating/reinvestment obligations, not automatically current debt.
